title: Airtable Team to self-hosted NocoDB
summary: NocoDB puts an Airtable-shaped interface on a Postgres database you own. Per-seat pricing is what makes this one work.

you_lose: Airtable's automations and scripting block — NocoDB's equivalents are thinner
The interface designer and published interfaces
A large marketplace of extensions and templates
you_gain: A real Postgres database underneath, queryable with SQL by anything you own
Free seats, which is the entire argument for teams above about four people

caveats: NocoDB has a direct Airtable import, which is why the migration estimate is low. Verify formula fields after import — they are the part that most often does not survive.
Attachment-heavy bases need more disk and more backup volume than the defaults here.
